state.paragraph: 50 parties, including CSC and Pamplona, who together we refer to as CSC/Pamplona, and Party A, to solicit potential interest in a transaction with Mac-Gray, 15 of which were potential strategic buyers and 35 of which were potential financial buyers, including private equity firms.

ledger_rows.Note: Special Committee of six independent directors formed; MacDonald and Rothenberg excluded from sale deliberations over potential rollover conflicts; sale seen as best path versus remaining standalone.
Filing reports 20 NDA signers (2 strategic, 18 financial); Party A, CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party C recorded individually; residual 16 financial bidders.
Round 1 due date reached; CSC/Pamplona submitted an indication; Party B and Party C submitted late and were reviewed on 07/25/2013.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
